definitions.explanation: A line or position established for defense against attack. Used literally in military contexts and figuratively for any last stand or boundary one tries to protect.

examples.japanese: {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}を{築|きず}く。
{最後|さいご}の{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}が{突破|とっぱ}された。
examples.english: The last line of defense was breached.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}{競争|きょうそう}で{利益|りえき}の{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}を{守|まも}るのが{難|むずか}しくなっている。
examples.english: It has become difficult to hold the line on profit margins amid price competition.

notes:
A compound of {防衛|ぼうえい} (defense) and {線|せん} (line). Used both literally for military defense positions and figuratively for any boundary or standard one tries to maintain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}を{張|は}る: to set up a defensive line
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}を{突破|とっぱ}する: to break through a defensive line
- {防衛線|ぼうえいせん}を{守|まも}る: to hold a defensive line
- {最終|さいしゅう}{防衛線|ぼうえいせん}: last line of defense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防御|ぼうぎょ}ライン: defense line — uses the loanword ライン
- {前線|ぜんせん}: front line — the forward-most position, not necessarily defensive
